digest.component_or_area: Jira DC live-integration readiness probe and harness
propositions: The live-DC readiness gate polls /rest/api/2/serverInfo until 200 but does not verify that required GreenHopper custom fields (Epic Link, Epic Name) are registered, causing the instance to be declared ready while those fields are absent.

A system-only field inventory (zero customfield_* entries) is treated as ready by the current gate, leading to failures in _assert_project_capabilities that misattribute missing plugin fields to an image degrade rather than incomplete initialization.
The harness wait_for_jira_dc_ready and the probe _await_named_fields use divergent readiness definitions, allowing them to drift; one must poll /rest/api/2/field while the other does not.

When readiness is declared too early (serverInfo 200 with no field check), subsequent test failures occur one second later with no customfield_* present, but the diagnostic message incorrectly points to an image contract regression.

The readiness predicate must distinguish between 'fields not yet registered' and 'this image does not offer these fields' so that genuine image degradations are not conflated with transient timing delays.
